analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($63.52) vs SMA5 ($67.24)/SMA20 ($67.46)/SMA50 ($64.97): below short/mid-term trends, indicating weakness.
· Position vs SMA100 ($61.16)/SMA200 ($58.44): approaching long-term support, neutral strength.
· 52-week position (75.1%) + current price level is in a downtrend from historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (62.1→38.9): confirmed entry into oversold territory, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.1189→-0.5199): continued worsening, signaling strengthening downtrend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $64.33): approaching lower band, confirming downward pressure.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($61.31): support zone based on Pivot S1 ($60.74) and SMA100 ($61.16).
· Swing resistance ($64.70): resistance zone at SMA50 ($64.97) and Pivot PP ($65.44).
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High): confirmed continuation of downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (2.08x): decline accompanied by surge in volume, confirming selling pressure.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): enter short on breaking below swing resistance $64.70, potential for further decline if support at $61.31 breaks.
